subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add an opt-in mode to ingest every Space message, and should that mode use Workspace Events/Pub/Sub and user or app authentication instead of the current service-account HTTP webhook model?
rationale: The remaining request changes which Space messages can reach OpenClaw, which credentials/scopes are stored, and how subscriptions are provisioned, so automation should not choose the privacy and security boundary.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as @mention/webhook-only for now and narrow or close this issue only after maintainers explicitly reject the broader visibility surface.

options.title: Split Remaining Work
options.body: Let focused thread/session fixes proceed separately while tracking all-message ingestion in a dedicated product and security design item.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from prior review on this issue plus sustained Google Chat API, docs, and security-sensitive plugin boundary work.
